build_regnet_backbone: build a RegNet backbone model using a predefined arch like regnetx_400mf or custom arch dict
run_regnet_forward: run a forward pass through a RegNet backbone model with a batch of input images
generate_regnet_widths: generate per-block widths and stage count from RegNet parameters w0, wa, wm, and depth
adjust_regnet_width_group: adjust stage widths and group widths to ensure compatibility with bottleneck ratio
get_regnet_stages: get the stage widths and block counts from a list of per-block widths
